differences: The paper's 485 epenthesis errors in the sham groups' practice /gd/ tokens counts only final codes typed exactly e; one token's final code is typed with trailing spaces (e plus spaces), which the authors' code does not count and the cleaned code does, so 486 here (Before 259 and During 258 agree).

The paper's 85.7% agreement between the two coders on whether a /gd/ token has an inserted vowel reproduces on the 1,600 practice /gd/ tokens (85.69%); over all 5,439 re-scored /gd/ tokens it is 84.4%.

27 cluster codes are typed with white space (c plus a space); the authors' cluster_correct is 0 on 27 of them, so those tokens are coded correct but scored incorrect in the shared file (kept as shared).

2 of the 5,439 re-scored /gd/ rows could not be attached to a single token (two tokens of the same recording session with the same word and code) and are not in the table; the authors' R scripts name two files (alldata_new_withorder_new.csv, gd_new_compquint.csv) that are not in the deposit, so the retention analyses of the paper could not be recomputed.
